_meta.description: Master intent router. Receives transcript (or audio) from the thin client, classifies intent with a fast LLM, dispatches to a sub-canvas, aggregates, runs TTS, streams response back over the originating WebSocket session.
_meta.concurrency: OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL=1; sub-canvases guarded by Redis mutex for <=5 users
_meta.auth: Per-device tokens. The Auth Check node calls the device-token service (DEVICE_TOKENS_URL, e.g. a small Postgres-backed HTTP endpoint or a Redis GET) with the deviceId from the body and compares the returned hash to the SHA-256 of the bearer token. Set DEVICE_TOKENS_URL in n8n env. Fallback: set ULTRON_DEVICE_TOKEN for single-user dev.

parameters._note: Looks up the stored SHA-256 hash for this deviceId. Returns {hash: '...'}. Skip this node (and set ULTRON_DEVICE_TOKEN) for single-user dev.
Used only when client sent audio instead of pre-transcribed text.

messages.content: You are the Ultron intent router. Output ONLY JSON matching the schema. Pick the single best intent. 'args' carries parsed entities (e.g. {since:'24h}).

parameters.jsCode:
const reply = $input.first().json.message?.content || $input.first().json.reply_text || '';
return [{ json: { reply_text: reply, context: $input.first().json } }];

parameters._note: piper returns 16k mono PCM; chunked over the WS session by the Response node.
For true chunked streaming over the persistent WebSocket, replace with a custom node writing to the session map keyed by sessionId.
